We employ Perplexity (PPL) as our primary metric (lower is better)... Besides, we also use sentence-level BLEU.

We employ Perplexity (PPL) as our primary metrics (lower is better) . Given a masked text span W =[w 1 , ..., w N ] and the model's prediction probability output P (W ), the log-perplexity is defined as, P P L(W ) = -1 N log P (W ). We report the perplexity in the log scale. Besides, we also use sentence-level BLEU.
